Redesigned the request and seed: the replica enforces unique `(team_id, channel_name)`, so multiple channels cannot share the exact name `launch-ops`.

What changed:
- Request now says "the launch channel" (not "#launch-ops"), formalized as `contains_ci "launch"` instead of `eq`. Every channel has a distinct name, so the seed installs cleanly.
- Name decoys no longer duplicate the target name: `release-ops` (F0, plain other name, same topic) and `deploy-ops` (F1, the word "Launch" appears in its purpose instead of its name).
- Topic decoys use distinct `launch-*` names that pass the loose name condition and fail only on topic: `launch-planning` (F1, requested text is its purpose) and `launch-alerts` (F0, different topic).
- Archived decoy is `launch-retro` (F0, same topic, archived). Background channels fail at least two conditions each.
- Action, effect, and anchor (invite `U_OMAR`) are unchanged.

Each decoy still fails exactly one human-readable condition, and every DROP mutation is killed by its witness.
